title: Beach Daze | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Beach Daze is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Located right on Highway 30A, this bright and cheery beach retreat is the perfect vacation spot for a family vacation. Beach Daze is just 240 feet from the Seacrest Drive Beach Access. Right out your front door is access to the scenic bike/walking trail, the best way to explore South Walton.Once you walk up to the spacious deck and open the doors, you will find a classic-styled Florida beach home. With 3 bedrooms, a full kitchen and living area, you will find plenty of room for a party of 6. Relax on the porch with your morning coffee or a glass of wine while enjoying a captivating view of the sunrise and sunset.With its Seacrest location, you're nestled in the peaceful area between Prominence and Alys Beach. Enjoy family activities, shopping and live music at The Big Chill in Prominence. Venture down to Alys for fine dining, festivals, and to sightsee the impeccable architecture. Enjoy bird watching and hiking at Camp Creek Lake (a rare coastal dune lake), or Deer Lake State Park. If you love the beaches, outdoors, world class dining, and a taste of classic 30A, Beach Daze is your place!Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV. Private bathroom with shower.Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV.Bedroom 3: 2 twin beds, TVBedrooms 2 and 3 share hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.Beach Access:From the front of the home, head across 30A to the bike trail. Head west on the trail just a few feet and you'll be at the Seacrest Drive Beach Access. Then just head down the scenic boardwalk and you're toes will be in the sand in no time.Distance: .1 miles | Time: 2 minutes walkingSeacrest:Seacrest is a perfect destination with beautiful white sand beaches, coastal dune lakes, open green spaces, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Located near all your favorite 30A communities like Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, Seaside, and Seagrove Beach, you’ll have swift access to a variety of shopping and dining venues that are spread out along the Gulf Coast. The 19-mile paved bike path that parallels the entire length of the scenic highway 30A makes getting around easy.Your stay at Beach Daze comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 4 cars* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 50 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further detailsAn initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
